text:
GoKnights reminds Arthur-Lovington/Atwood-Hammond High School students about Picture Day and deadlines
Arthur-Lovington/Atwood-Hammond High School’s official account, #GoKnights, issued several reminders and announcements to students on August 19, 2026, covering Picture Day, dental service forms, and daily updates.
In a post at 11:00 a.m. on August 19, #GoKnights wrote: "REMINDER... Picture Day is TOMORROW! Seniors ... this picture will be used for the yearbook, graduation, newspaper, and beyond! Look your best!" This message was directed particularly at seniors whose photos will be featured in various school-related publications.
Later that day at 1:40 p.m., the account posted another update regarding student health documentation: "Sarah Bush Lincoln Dental Service forms have been sent home with the high school students. Forms are due back by August 31."
A third post at 5:13 p.m. provided a link to general daily information: "Announcements: Wednesday, August 19, 2026".
Arthur-Lovington/Atwood-Hammond High School serves grades nine through twelve and had an enrollment of 328 students during the 2019-2020 academic year. The school is located in Arthur within Douglas County (Illinois Report Card). Demographic data from that period shows that grade nine had the largest group of students at 39 percent of total enrollment (Illinois Report Card). Additionally, grade ten comprised about 28.6 percent of students; grade eleven made up approximately 26.4 percent; and seniors represented roughly 27.9 percent. The student body was predominantly white (94.5 percent), with smaller percentages identifying as black (1.5 percent), Hispanic (2.7 percent), or Asian (0.3 percent) (Illinois Report Card).
These recent communications reflect ongoing efforts by Arthur-Lovington/Atwood-Hammond High School to keep its community informed about key events and deadlines throughout the academic year.
